title: unidrnd
summary: Generate random integers from a discrete uniform distribution.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host for compatibility until provider sampling hooks exist.

description: `unidrnd(n)` generates random integers from `1` through `n`. Size arguments can be supplied as separate dimensions or as a size vector.
behaviors: `n` must contain positive integer-valued single or double values.
Native typed-integer `n` is a RunMat extension. It is gated before gather and admitted only when every value is exactly representable at the binary64 sampling boundary.
Scalar `n` broadcasts over the requested output size.
Array `n` requires the requested size to match the shape of `n`.
A single size argument creates a square matrix, following MATLAB random-size conventions.
Documented size controls are single or double. Native typed-integer sizes are a separately gated RunMat extension and are decoded exactly as structural extents.

faqs.question: What class does unidrnd return?
faqs.answer: RunMat returns double-precision numeric values, matching the common MATLAB numeric result shape.
